independent_unit: prompt; average two seeds within prompt
test: exact two-sided paired sign-flip over 4096 signs; Holm across two primary endpoints at .05

temporal.empty_mask: retain zero coverage and null residual; full affected cell/window residual mean and paired contrast undefined

primary_nonfinite: halt as invalid pending review; no replacement or amplitude tuning
heldout_access_requires: frozen implementation, analysis, protocol, prompt and passed-gate hashes committed before any held-out BF16 generation
runtime_estimate_status: unmeasured budget only; measure all arms before final registration
noise_structure_controls: deferred separate protocol; not part of 96 trajectories
